The next second, as the executioner approached, he used the very chains meant to bind him to strangle the man’s neck. The scent of citrus mixed with the smell of blood wafted through the air as the white flower bloomed, revealing a pitch-black core. “Officer, tell me, between the two of us, who looks more like a prisoner now?”
Wealthy Elite (Heirs) World:
Watching the disabled CEO, whom he had painstakingly cared for for three years, holding a reborn Bug in his arms (who used mind-reading to frame him). The once-inferior, deeply affectionate “canary” who only knew how to give pale explanations that he was not after the money suddenly changed. He picked up a nearby vase and smashed it directly against the CEO’s newly recovered knees. Amidst the wailing and screams, the man’s red lips curled slightly. “Come, listen closely. What is your ‘Little White Moonlight’ thinking in their heart right now?”
Entertainment Industry World:
An 18th-tier actor, whose breakout role was stolen by an “Awakened Bug” using bullet-chat spoilers and who suffered from cyberbullying, suddenly transformed. He became the “Script Boss” that every director and actor in the industry scrambled to please. “Tell me, are there more people on the screen cursing me now, or more people laughing at you?”
In every world: Chu Sicheng successfully ground the Bugs into the dirt. However, why is he fighting with his “Official Love Interest” (the protagonist’s fated partner) every single day?
What kind of “bright and sunny” protagonist hangs out with the “gloomy villain” all day?
He is even teaching the villain how to be even more ruthless!
The Bureau was stunned: “Recall him! Recall him immediately to change his mission style!” However, just as the Bureau prepared to force a recall, the villain, who had been quietly following Chu Sicheng like a loyal lackey, stood directly in front of him.
With eyes as cold as ice, the villain demanded: “Who is trying to instigate my boyfriend to cheat?”
If I am the fruit of an evil seed, why not use ‘Villain’ as my name?
One-sentence summary: I am really the protagonist, believe me!
Theme: Stay true to yourself, and a bright future will come.
